Change c0302. Location: 1818 Vol. II, Ch. VIII; 1831 Ch. XVI.

Context before (unchanged): I trembled violently, apprehending some dreadful misfortune.

1818 text: The inside of the cottage was dark, and I heard no motion; I cannot describe the agony of this suspence.

1831 text: The inside of the cottage was dark, and I heard no motion; I cannot describe the agony of this suspense.

Diff: The inside of the cottage was dark, and I heard no motion; I cannot describe the agony of this [-suspence-] {+suspense+} .

Context after (unchanged): "Presently two countrymen passed by; but, pausing near the cottage, they entered into conversation, using violent gesticulations; but I did not understand what they said, as they spoke the language of the country, which differed from that of my protectors.

result.rationale: Only the orthography changes: 'suspence' becomes 'suspense'. The word and meaning are identical, so there is no interpretive consequence.
